Name: (CP) BB's New Livestock - Shoebills and Loftwings
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[b][size=4]Increase your animal diversity by adding Shoebills to your barn![/size]

[/b]Misplaced in an unfortunate forklifting accident, a few fragile shoebill eggs found their way into a shipment bound for Stardew Valley. Imagine Marnie's surprise when instead of exotic emus a group of silvery shoebills were born. After 4 days, chicks grew a powerful bill and long legs. Their bill-clattering is intimidating to strangers. Some seem to have grown... a tail?
[size=4]
[/size][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds shoebill birds as a new animal to Marnie's shop! 
[*]Shoebills will produce shoebill eggs every 2 days that can be converted into mayonnaise (1 egg : 1 mayo), sold, given to grateful villagers, or incubate using an ostrich incubator in the barn to hatch a shoebill chick! 
[*]After 5 heart's of animal friendship, shoebills will start shedding feathers, presenting them to you as a gift
[*]Chicks will hatch after 5 in game days, and mature into adults after 4 days
[*]NEW! Incorporate a bit of fantasy by using one of the new Loftwing skins from The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword! 
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation Notes

[/b][/size]This mod requires both SMAPI and Content Patcher to work correctly! 
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download and unzip "[CP] BBs Shoebills" ver 1.1 (if you previously downloaded ver 1.0, delete that folder first!)
[*]Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
[/list]Enjoy!

Buying all variants from Marnie requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazar[/url], a mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url] that allows you to purchase all of an animal's skin variants easily in the shop. If you do not have this mod, though I [u]highly recommend[/u] it, you will have to set the skin that appears in Marnie's shop manually using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], and choosing a default. In the 1.1.1 version I removed a config.json that was accidentally included in 1.1 during testing. Sorry about that!

If you do not have either Livestock Bazar or GMCM, you can still get loftwings, however it will be dependant on RNG, as the loftwing skins have a lower probability of hatching from eggs than the default shoebill. ﻿

[size=4][b]Patch Notes[/b][/size]

Ver 1.1.1 - Updated for Content Patcher 2.9.0, added a custom mayonnaise sprite, updated the feather sprite, added 3 new skins based on TLOZ Loftwings, edited produce arguments to incorporate professions better. Removed an accidentally included testing config.json. 

[size=4][b]Future Update Wishlist[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Incorporate into recipes, add picked shoebill eggs [/size]
[/list][size=2]
If you have any requests or suggestions please leave a comment or shoot me a message! :> [/size]
